patch_description: The best prior variant (combined 0.54) was the innovation-adaptive Kalman prefilter followed by robust exponentially-weighted local quadratic regression evaluated at the window end — it achieved correlation 0.93-0.94 and noise_reduction 0.50-0.57, far better than the current trend-lock design (0.34 noise reduction, 0.53 combined). The current trend-lock hysteresis over-suppresses dynamics, hurting responsiveness and noise reduction. This edit replaces the trend-lock core with that proven pipeline, then adds a NEW final stage: a locally adaptive median-snap on output differences. Small point-to-point differences that deviate little from a rolling median of diffs are snapped to the median, which removes residual jitter (slope churn / false reversals) without a global threshold — noisy non-stationary segments get aggressive snapping via a rolling MAD-of-diffs, clean segments keep their dynamics. This directly targets slope_changes and false_reversals (the multi-objective smoothness terms) while the quadratic fit's t=0 evaluation keeps phase lag near zero, and the Kalman slope state preserves responsiveness.
